name: Imperial Business School, Imperial College London

program.length_note: Optional extended term to 16 months, subject to an additional tuition fee

class_size.note: Class size not shown on the class profile page

tuition_total.note: Same fee for UK and international students. Covers Global Experience Week flights and accommodation and core materials. Non-refundable deposit counts towards the fee.

mandatory_fees_total.note: No mandatory fee beyond tuition. Optional Careers Club membership GBP 10 per club per year.

living_budget_total.note: Imperial College 'Likely costs for living in London - 2026' (all students). 9-month average range GBP 16,392-17,042; monthly lower GBP 1,264, upper GBP 2,118.

awards.name: Dean's Impact Scholarship
awards.amount: Up to 50% of the tuition fee

awards.name: Forte Fellowships for Women
awards.amount: Up to 50% of the tuition fee

scholarship.note: Award amounts listed; no average award or share of class published.

base_salary.note: Average salary in PPP US dollars, as published. No GBP figure and no median on the page. Figures refer to graduates seeking employment who shared data.

employment.by_industry_note: Only the tech share is published on the web page. Full sector breakdown is in the Class of 2025 report, downloadable only through a HubSpot form (not retrieved).
employment.by_geography_note: Only the UK share is published on the web page.
employment.top_employers_note: Employers of graduates 'in the last three years' (web page), not Class of 2025 only; no hire counts.

rankings_cited.note: school rankings page: 'Full-Time MBA, 2026 (published in February 2026)' 39th in the world, 12th in Europe

notes: Weakest employment data of the UK four: full report gated behind a form. Salary is a PPP USD mean.
